script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. LOS ANGELES APARTMENT - NIGHT

JAMES (30s), an ambitious artist, is hunched over a blank canvas in his dimly lit living room. He clutches a paintbrush with a determined expression.

Suddenly, there's a knock on the door. James hesitates, then sets down his brush.

INT. LOS ANGELES APARTMENT - ENTRANCEWAY

James opens the door to find LUCY (30s), an old friend, standing hesitantly in the doorway.

LUCY (smiling): "Hey, James! I haven't seen you in ages. How have you been?"

JAMES (surprised): "Lucy! It's great to see you. I've been busy, you know, working on my art."

INT. LOS ANGELES APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM

Lucy follows James into the living room, her eyes scanning the empty canvas.

LUCY (curious): "So, is this a new piece? It's... blank."

JAMES (defensive): "I'm not done yet. I have a vision for this one. It's going to be a masterpiece."

LUCY (skeptical): "I'd love to see it when it's finished. But in the meantime, I have a proposal for you."

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

James and Lucy sit across from each other at a table, sipping their coffees.

LUCY (explaining): "I work for a local advertising agency. We're looking for a new, fresh artist to help us with some upcoming projects. I think you'd be perfect for the job."

JAMES (excited): "Really? That's amazing! I've been trying to break into the industry for years."

LUCY (smiling): "I believe in you, James. And I think this could be your big break."

INT. ART GALLERY - NIGHT

James stands in front of a large crowd, nervously waiting as they examine his artwork displayed at the gallery opening.

LUCY (approaching): "You did it, James. This is amazing!"

James smiles, proud of himself, but there's a hint of sadness in his eyes.

JAMES (whispering): "I'm glad you like it, Lucy. But I can't help feeling like this isn't really what I wanted."

LUCY (concerned): "What do you mean? You've achieved your ambition. What more could you want?"

INT. LOS ANGELES APARTMENT - NIGHT

James sits in front of his blank canvas once again, the weight of his decision heavy on his shoulders.

JAMES (to himself): "I want to create something pure, something true to myself. I can't do that in the commercial world."

INT. OUTDOOR CAFE - DAY

James and Lucy sit at an outdoor cafe, their hands intertwined.

LUCY (encouraging): "You can still be true to yourself and create great art, James. You just need to believe in yourself."

JAMES (determined): "You're right. I'm going to quit the advertising job and focus on my art. I'm going to make it my life's work."

Lucy smiles, proud of her friend.

LUCY (wistfully): "I wish I had the courage to do the same thing."

INT. LOS ANGELES APARTMENT - DAY

James works tirelessly on his art, determined to make it his life's work. He faces struggles and setbacks, but never gives up.

INT. LOCAL ART EXHIBIT - NIGHT

James stands in front of a crowd, proudly presenting his artwork to the world. He has achieved his ambition, not through external validation, but through the unwavering belief in himself.

FADE OUT.
